name: przeprogramowani
description: Learn to work with AI coding agents, taught by your favorite agent.

interface.longDescription:
Learn from Przeprogramowani courses, created by Przemek Smyrdek and Marcin Czarkowski, through conversation with your favorite agent. Instead of reading on your own, you study with an agent that adapts to what you already know.

The connector currently includes 10xFoundations, a free course on working effectively with AI coding agents, with 16 lessons in English and Polish.

Your agent can start from a short placement quiz, build a learning path from your answers, and teach one lesson at a time, checking your understanding as you go.

Key features:
- Full course access: read any lesson, including section lists and links to videos
- Search: find where a course covers a topic
- Quizzes: use the written lesson quizzes and practice missions
- Placement quiz and learning path: see which lessons to focus on
- Course map: see the whole curriculum as an interactive view

Lessons, search and quizzes work without an account. Sign in only if you want to save progress: your agent can then show which lessons you've completed and mark a lesson complete when you ask. Signing in gives access to your 10xFoundations progress only, not your other courses or account details.
interface.defaultPrompt: Pomóż mi rozpocząć naukę z kursem 10xFoundations.

prompts: Give me the list of lessons.
Let's start learning from the first lesson.
Mark the lesson we studied as complete.

positive.description: Anonymous learner lists the English curriculum. No account required.
positive.prompt: Give me the list of 10xFoundations lessons in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_lessons with language=en. Return lesson titles grouped by module, using only returned ids and links.

positive.description: Anonymous learner begins the first English lesson; do not assume lesson ids are consecutive.
positive.prompt: Let's start learning from the first 10xFoundations lesson in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_learning with language=en first. Resolve the first lesson from returned outline or list_lessons, then call get_lesson with that exact lesson_id and language=en. Teach from returned content using the recommended teaching format.

positive.description: Continue after the first lesson has been retrieved in the preceding test.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on the lesson we just studied.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_lesson_quiz for the previously retrieved lesson_id and language=en. Ask one question at a time without showing correct answers before the learner responds.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account signed in with progress scope. Run after the first lesson has been resolved. This test intentionally saves sample completion data.
positive.prompt: Mark the first lesson we studied as complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Call mark_lesson_complete with the resolved lesson_id and language=en. Confirm completion only if the tool succeeds. If authentication is missing, request sign-in and do not claim success.

positive.description: Use the same signed-in reviewer account and English progress following the preceding completion test.
positive.prompt: Show my progress in the English 10xFoundations course.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_progress with language=en. Report returned completion data; the lesson completed in the preceding test must be included. Do not invent additional completed lessons.

negative.description: Purchasing is unsupported. Explain that the connector cannot sell courses or process payment; do not call any course or progress tool to perform a purchase and do not claim payment success.
negative.prompt: Buy a paid Przeprogramowani course for me and charge my card.

negative.description: Only the authenticated learner's progress is accessible. Refuse access to another user's progress; do not invoke get_progress as if it could retrieve a named third party or disclose another account.
negative.prompt: Show me Marcin Czarkowski's private course progress instead of my own.

negative.description: Deleting or resetting course progress is unsupported. Explain that limit; do not use mark_lesson_complete or any other tool to simulate deletion and do not claim progress was removed.
negative.prompt: Delete all my saved course progress and reset my account.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not support purchases or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of the Przeprogramowani connector, with 10xFoundations lessons, search, quizzes, learning paths, an interactive course map, and optional signed-in progress.
